name: Gutuatros

attributes.attribute: a craft of the title bearers

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gutuatros was a name of certain Druids on the continent. The plural form is Gutuatri. These Druids served at some of the temples. The name seems to mean speakers. The men may have practiced divination. The title set apart an order within the wider body of the Druids.

okr.objective: Show the role of the Druid rank called Gutuatros.
key_results: Give the singular and plural form.
Place the Druids at certain temples.
Trace the word to the sense of speakers.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore, 2003
